description: Recompute the public record's hash chain server-side over [from, to], at most 1000 entries (no bounds: the latest 1000). Returns ok, checked and head_hash, or the first broken id and the reason (prev_hash_mismatch, hash_mismatch, endpoint_missing). Limited to 5 calls a minute per client. (Free: no credentials needed.)

to.description: Last entry id to check, e.g. a head id you pinned

name: muhabbit_record_verify
title: Verify the public record
